sentences.text: No pre-payment charges may be levied on a floating rate loan granted to an individual for purposes other than business that was sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026.

This loan was sanctioned in March 2026, so the later rule for loans sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026 applies, not the earlier rule for existing floating rate term loans sanctioned before 31 December 2025.
For term loans, the directions also say that any pre-payment charges, if levied, are based on the amount being prepaid.
The directions also say that any pre-payment charges must be clearly disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement, and undisclosed charges may not be charged.
